## Reproduction Steps

Discovered while validating epic ce0e (xdist parallelization). The live-Jira
reconciler E2E `test_delete_permission_probe` flakes on Jira's search-index
eventual consistency when the *whole* live group runs (it self-skips in CI, so
this only bites a local live run with creds).

- `pytest tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py` (all 12, SERIAL, no xdist)
  → `test_delete_permission_probe` FAILS: `AssertionError: created issue REB-NNNN
  never became index-visible` (observed REB-1105 and REB-1107 on two runs).
- `pytest "…::test_delete_permission_probe"` in ISOLATION (serial) → PASSES.

So the failure is load/timing dependent (many live tests hammering the shared
test project's index in one run outrun the test's index-visibility poll timeout),
NOT caused by xdist — it reproduces with `-n0`. Independent of epic ce0e's change.

## Expected vs Actual

- Expected: the index-visibility wait polls long enough (or backs off) to absorb
  Jira's eventual-consistency lag even when the full live group has just created
  many issues.
- Actual: the fixed poll budget in the visibility helper (`test_reconcile_live_e2e.py:347`)
  times out under group load and the test fails.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The index-visibility wait in `tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py`
  is made robust to group-load lag so the full live group passes reliably.
  DONE via Gerrit 1914 (merged as 09abac969c): a `_fresh_search(client, jql)` helper evicts the
  per-JQL cache entry before delegating, so every poll iteration actually re-queries Jira. Root
  cause was `AcliClient.search_issues` memoizing per-JQL and caching NEGATIVE results forever,
  reducing the 120s poll to a single-shot check. This AC's original parenthetical ("longer/adaptive
  backoff") was misleading: no timeout, budget, or sleep interval was changed, and tuning them
  could not have fixed it.

- [x] A deterministic offline oracle guards the re-query mechanism: a test drives the helper
  against a real `AcliClient` stubbed only at the subprocess seam, and fails if the poll stops
  re-querying. Code-verifiable in `tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py` at 09abac969c.

- [x] [operator-attested] Against the live test project, the previously-failing scenario no longer
  reports `never became index-visible`.
  provenance: environment=live Jira Cloud test project (REB) reached via acli; principal=the configured JIRA_USER API-token credential used by the reconciler; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — index visibility is a property of the remote Jira search index and cannot be observed from the repository at any commit, so no static or offline check can establish this outcome.
  Evidence: a live run BEFORE the fix reproduced the reported failure exactly (`AssertionError:
  created issue REB-3241 never became index-visible ... in 125.72s` — the full budget burned, as
  the mechanism predicts); AFTER the fix the same live scenario completes in roughly 5-8s.
  LIMITATION recorded honestly: the post-fix live confirmation was ONE run, not the repeated series
  the original wording asked for. Judged sufficient because this same AC was previously certified
  by three clean serial runs later PROVEN to be coincidence — under the cached-negative defect
  those runs passed only when the index happened to converge before the first query. Run-count was
  never the evidence that mattered; the mechanism is, and it is now pinned by the offline oracle
  above.

- [x] No change to CI behavior (these tests still self-skip without live creds).
  DONE: test-only change, no production code touched, `@_requires_live` guard unchanged.
